tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la klu chen brgyad bskor gyi char 'bebs dngos grub sprin phung bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā la ya/ rab 'jigs dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa'i sku/ /rab snyan hūm̐ phaṭa nga ro sgrog pa'i gsung / /rab 'byams chos kun bde stong rol pa'i thugs/ /gu ru ma hā kā la bi dza ya/ /gang la brten nas phrin las rnam bzhi yi/ /las tshogs gdams pa bsam gyis mi khyab las/ /'dir ni 'gro kun dbul ba sel ba'i phyir/ /char 'bebs gdams pa dngos grub sprin phung 'bri/ /'dir dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po la klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'i sgo nas char dbab pa'i man ngag ni/ rnal 'byor pa bsnyen sgrub las su rung zhing gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa 'di skor gyi gdams pa yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gang zag gis klu gnas nges pa'i chu mig gam/ yang na rang gi sgrub khang la sogs pa dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung gi rten bris 'bur byin rlabs can ji ltar 'tshams pa bzhugs su gsol ba'i drung du gtor bsngo bskang ba'i gtor ma rang rang gi phyag len bzhin la bdud rtsi ril bu tsam ma gtogs dmar skyur gyi dri ma med pa/ spro na dkar gsum mngar gsum la sogs pa rgyud sde 'og ma dang thun mong ba'i rdzas rnams dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung bkod pa mdzes shing gtsang sbras brgyan pa bshams/ gnas de'i nub phyogs su ras dar la sogs pa kha dog dkar po dri ma med pa gting pa'i khar nas 'bras gro sogs bkram/ dkar gong sogs rdo bskyor gyi khar dmar skyur gyi ma gos pa'i rdza gzhong ngam/ zangs gzhong gi nang du chab gtsang ma la ba dmar ra dkar gyi 'o ma thigs pa re blugs/ seng ge sgra'i gdon grol gyi gzhung nas 'byung ba'i klu sman rnams sbyar ma'am khro'am phye ma gang rung btab/

bag zan la sbal gzugs bcos par gsungs kyang chu skyon mi 'byung ba'i phyir mar la sbal gzugs bcos pa'i khog par klu sman bcug te sngar gyi 'o chu la klu sman dang bcas dkyil du mgo rang la bstan nas bzhag de'i khar dur khrod kyi g.yam pa'am/ rdo leb kyi ngos la gur gum gyis byugs pa'i gzhir mtshal gyi padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su mgon sku byin rlabs can/ sku mdun du chu bdag wa ru ṇa/ 'dab ma brgyad la klu brgyad kyi gzugs 'jim pa'am/ bag zan la bzos pa shar nas bzung kha nang bstan g.yas bskor du bkod pa'am/ yang na 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hūm̐ 'dab ma brgyad la phu brgyad yig mgo phyir bstan du bris pa de'i gzhong pas kha bcad mtshams rnams 'jim pa'am bag zan gyis bsdams la rlung mi rgyu bar bya/ de'i phyir ras dar sngon po gang rung gi gur phub/ de'i drung du mgon po'i gtor ma zlum po zas sna dang bcas pa mañdzi la sogs pa'i khar bzhag shar nas bzung chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod g.yas bskor du bshams/ de'i mdun du klu rnams la zangs la sogs pa'i gtor theb bzhir zan ril bzhi bzhi'am/ gtor chung bzhi bzhi gang rung bshams pa'o/ /chab klu sman dar snas mdzes par bsham/ 'di 'og tu 'bul ba'i tshe klu gtor nas 'byung ba bzhin 'bul rgyu yin pas/ gtor theb gnyis re sdebs la bsngos pa tshar brgyad 'bul dgos/ gtor ma zan ril gang byed kyang rim pas lugs rgyur snod gcig tu drug cu rtsa bzhi bshams/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril nang mchod ḍā ma ru 'thor snod rnams phyag len bzhin bsham ste kha nub tu phyogs la mdun bskyed dang zhal sprod du byas te/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas par bya'o/ /'dir nang mchod phud chang gnyis kyang chu la nas 'bras gang rung btab pa la chang dngos kyi dod bya'o/ /de nas sgrub pa po rnams kyis dges rdor ram/ gur mgon gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/

gtor bsngo rang rang gi phyag len bzhin bshams nas/ mdun gyi char 'bebs kyi rdzas rten rnams dang bcas pa/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du gnas yid du 'ong ba rin po che'i brag ri dang / mtsho dang rdzing bu dang / ne'u gseng dang / pho brang dang / skyed mos tshal la sogs rnams su gang 'dod pa'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang / klu'i nad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen pos yongs su gang bar gyur/ de'i dbus su paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ zhes pa nas/ mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar gyi mgon po bskyed nas/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi pho brang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang sogs nas rdo rje nag po chen po la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ mgon po kun gshegs rten la gshegs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga ba'i dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī badzra ma hā kā la ye e hye hi badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye arghaṃ nas shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ gyis gdan 'bul/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chu'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ mgon po'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ gi mthar sngags phreng gi bskor ba la rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros pa phog pas thugs rgyud bskul nas char 'bebs pa'i phrin las mdzad par bsam la/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa brgya stong la sogs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon pos 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu 'bebs pa'i phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la mgon po'i zlum gtor kyai rdor gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ shā sa na lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pas phul/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye arghaṃ nas shapta pra tītstsha swāhā'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung ba'i/ /nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa/ /zhal gcig mdog sngo cher 'bar zhing / /zangs gri thod pa bsnams la bstod/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal byas/ /mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung / /bong thung gzi brjid chen po ste/ /zhal dmar rnam par g.yo la bstod/ /slob dpon la rtag sdang ba dang / /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum la gnod/ /sems can sna tshogs gsod pa rnams/ /za byed nag po che la bstod/ /dpal 'bar ma hā kā la ye/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen pos mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir sogs gong bzhin brjod pa'i phrin las bcol/

mgon po'i mdun dang 'dab ma brgyad la nam dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su chu bdag wa ru ṇa dkar po bka' nod pa'i tshul du gnas pa/ shar du stobs rgyu sngon po/ lhor dung skyong ser po/ nub tu mtha' yas dkar po/ byang du nor rgyas ser po/ shar lhor 'jog po dmar po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan dkar po/ nub byang du padma dmar po/ byang shar du padma chen po sngon po thams cad kyang kha dog dag pa'i shel ltar dwangs shing yul gyi dbang po sna tshogs su snang ba/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ stod lha'i lus can spyi gtsug na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang bcas pa'i sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i dbus na chu'i rkyal pa 'dzin pas char chen po 'bebs pa la brtson pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil nas klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis bkug la/ oṃ brta li brta li ma hā brta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dza dza swāhā/ oṃ a gatstsha ya a gatstsha ya ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sarba bhurbhu wa phruṃ phruṃ phu hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum la sogs pa brjod de dmigs pa gsal bas spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ padma kā ma la ya satwaṃ gyis gdan phul/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyis nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhab bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ arghaṃ nas/ shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/

gdangs yod pa'am med kyang rung / dri med yid du 'ong ba lha rdzas kyi/ /mchod yon rgya mtshos klu rgyal 'khor bcas mchod/ /'jig rten khams kyi skye dgu thams cad la/ /phun tshogs char gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ na ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra ti tstsha swāhā/ dri med yid du 'ong ba༞ /zhabs bsil rgya mtshos klu rgyal༞ /'jig rten khams kyi skye dgu༞ /phun tshogs char gyis dngos grub༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ pā dyaṃ༞ dri med yid du 'ong ba༞ /me tog sil mas klu rgyal༞ /skye dgu༞ /char gyi dngos grub༞ /puṣpe༞ dri med yid du 'ong ba༞ /dri zhim spos kyi klu rgyal༞ /skye dgu༞ /dngos grub༞ /dhū pe༞ dri med yid du 'ong ba༞ /mar me'i 'od kyi klu rgyal༞ /skye dgu༞ /char gyi dngos grub༞ /ā lo ke༞ dri med yid du 'ong ba༞ /dri bzang byugs pas klu rgyal༞ /skye dgu༞ /char gyi dngos grub༞ /gandhe༞ dri med yid du 'ong ba༞ /ro brgya'i bshos kyis klu rgyal༞ /skye dgu༞ /char gyi dngos grub༞ /nai wi dyaṃ༞ /dri med yid du 'ong ba༞ /snyan pa'i sgra yis klu rgyal༞ /skye dgu༞ /char gyi dngos grub༞ /shapta༞ dharma ra ṇi rol chen/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i bstod pas bstod/ klu'i rgyal po'i thugs khar zla ba'i steng du so so'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba las/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bskul bas/ gang bcol pa'i phrin las thams cad sgrub par bsam/ oṃ phuḥwa ru ṇa ya na ga rā dza phu hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ de bzhin du gong 'og 'dra ba las mtshan sngags kyi thad du/ karko ṭa ye/ shaṃ kha pā la ye/ a nanta ye/ bā su ka ye/ takṣa ka ye/ ku li ka ye/ padma ye/ ma hā padma ye zhes sbyar la/ so so nas nyer gcig la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i rjes su/ klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir sogs gong bzhin no/ /de nas gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi 'bul ba ni gtor theb dang po gnyis/

a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ thal mo khong stong gi phyag rgya dang / oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ ā dya nutpanna twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ mthar se gol gtogs pa lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ lag g.yon khu tshur mas mthe bong dang mthe'u chung sgrengs/ g.yas sor mo rnams brkyangs te de'i steng du kha phub pa klu dga' ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phruṃ phruṃ swāhā/ oṃ bhakṣa ya bhakṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣṭha dzuṃ phruṃ phu hūm̐ swāhā/ gtor theb gnyis la lan gsum gsum ste drug phul/ sngags tshan gnyis so so'i mthar se gol re gtogs/ phul zin pa dang thal mo sbyar nas/ de ltar na klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis gtso byas pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi rigs thams cad dang / khyad par du yang yul phyogs 'dir gnas cing lan chags pa'i sha 'khon du gnyer ba'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi rigs thams cad la sbyin no/ /gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dis tshim zhing mnyes nas gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam pa zhi nas phan pa dang zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur nas/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir sogs gong bzhin/ yang bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs nas/ phrin 'chol gyi bar tshar bdun re yongs dril brgyad phul tshar re bzhin gyi snod gcig tu bsags/ bshal chu btang / gsar pa bsham pa sogs rim pa bzhin bya/ de yang tshan pa re la gtor theb gnyis gnyis su gcod pa ni klu brgyad gtso bor gyur pa'i gtor ma'i ril bu brgyad 'byung la/ tshan pa 'bul ba ni/ klu re re la'ang brgyad brgyad phul bas yongs dril drug cu rtsa bzhi 'byung ba yin cing / gtso bo wa ru ṇa de dag spyi khyab tu 'du bas klu brgyad gsungs la gnod cing lan chags pa rnams kyang dpon 'gro g.yog 'gro'i tshul du tshim par bsam pa ni dmigs pa'i gnad do/

/de nas mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs gong bzhin la/ oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas shapta'i mthar rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ chu bdag stobs rgyu la sogs klu dbang rnams/ /chu gter rgya mtsho gting mtha' rab zab nas/ /rin chen sna tshogs kyis sprad yid 'ong ba'i/ /pho brang 'byor pa che ldan dbus na bzhugs/ /dbu la sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka'i tshogs dbus na/ /yid bzhin nor bu bsam kun rdzogs mdzad cing / /bdag gzhan don 'byor phun tshogs 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'od 'bar la sogs mun sel rnams kyis brgyan/ /tshe rabs du mar yon tan legs sbyangs nas/ /klu dbang 'byor pa mtha' yas yang dag rdzogs/ /rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs che la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab khyod la 'dud/ /dad ldan rgyal bas bka' thos zhal mthong zhing / /bsgrub la brtson pas sangs rgyas thugs su chud/ /thabs dang snying rjes gzhan don rdzogs mdzad pa/ /bdag dang gzhan don 'byor pa khyod la 'dud/ /sngon tshe bde gshegs spyan sngar bka' bsgos te/ /bstan pa srung dang 'gro la phan gdags phyir/ /dam las mi 'das dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /gsol btab las mdzod bdag don yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /klu yi rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ de nas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' stod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi༞ bdag cag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa de'i mthus klu chen po dgu'i gtso byas pa'i klu dang sa bdag gi rigs thams cad mdun gyi sbal gzugs 'di nyid la thim par gyur cig

nā ga a karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/ klu rnams kyis phyi rol du 'od kyi lcags ris bskor nas char 'bebs kyi las ma grub bar skad cig kyang phyir 'gro sa med par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi mgon po'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros klu dgu'i gtso byas pas klu dang sa bdag thams cad la phog pas rgyud bskul/ rang gi lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga dang sbrul mgo rnams kyi kha dang / gnas dang sa phyogs thams cad nas chu rlangs bsil ba'i rang bzhin can bsam gyi mi khyab pa g.yos nas stong gsum gyi nam mkha' thams cad khyab bar byas te char bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'bebs pa'i phrin las mdzad par gyur/ zhes brjod la dmigs pa brtan pos/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la aṣṭa nā na ku ru ni shig ni ri ma tha ni shig ma shi da ra ni shig nā ga rā dza de wa ba ri sha ya shig hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya stong la sogs pa ji ltar rig pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar so so'i mtshan sngags sbyar bas mchod/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba po/ /mgon po gri gug thod pa can/ /kha dog nag cing ro la zhon/ /nag po che la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ /sa 'og mun pa mtha' dag sel mdzad cing / /bstan la rab dga' sprul pa bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa sogs shlau ka gcig gi mthar dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dang / klu chen dgu 'khor dang bcas pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir sogs gong bzhin/ de nas bskang ba byed par spro na dril gsil ma tsam bya/ rnga brdung sogs rgyas pa ni don la 'gal ba med kyang / ltar snang la cho ga 'di klu dang 'brel bas babs mi chags pa lta bur mngon pas bsdus pa bya/ de nas yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/

bzod gsol brtan bzhugs gshegs gsol go bgo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams bdag bskyed gang yin pa de'i rjes 'brel bya'o/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyis zhag gsum lnga bdun la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa bsgrubs pas nges par char 'bebs par 'gyur zhing / gshegs gsol gyi nyin gtor mgron gshegs gsol gyi mthar/ sngar gyi 'od kyi lcags ri de mi dmigs par gyur/ thal mo sbyar la/ sman dang sngags sogs byin brlabs kyis/ /nad dang nyer 'tshe kun spangs nas/ /drin lan dam tshig dran gyis la/ /rang rang gnas su 'gro bar gyis/ /ma hā nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha zhes dang / lag pa gnyis rgyab sbyar ba'i mtheb srin gyi se gol bya/ lag pa rgyab sbyar ba de'i mu las mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel/ mthe bong gnyis lag mthil du bkug sor mo lhag ma rnams gshib ste/ cung zad thur du brkyang pa bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas la/ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swāhā/ zhes brjod la/ go bgo ba sogs bya/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /rdzas dang yo byad gtsang ma rnams klu gnas nges pa'i chu mig tu bskyal/ mgon sku dang sku gzugs yod na sa phyogs dben pa zhig tu bzhugs su gsol ba'am/ gal te klu gzugs bag zan yin na mgo 'jug dang go rim ma 'dzol bar byas la chu mig tu bskyal/ padmar sa bon bris pa yin na/ dri bzang gi chus phyi'o/ /de dag ni gnas skabs su sprin 'thor ba sdud pa dang / rlung gnon pa dang / ser ba bsrung 'bebs dang sad srung ba rnams man ngag gi yi ge dang / zhal las shes par bya'o/ /zhes dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la klu chen dgu'i bskor ba'i char 'bebs kyi yi ge dngos grub sprin phung zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis snyigs ma'i dus 'di'i sems can rnams mu ge'i 'jigs pa las skyabs pa'i phyir tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal/

sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa a mes zhabs sogs kyis mdzad pa'i char 'bebs chab klu'i yi ge sogs las btus te go bde ba'i ngag gi bkod pa 'di'i 'dzam gling dbul ba las rgyal nas mi zad pa'i gter la longs spyod par gyur cig/ ༈ /oṃ swasti/ mgon po'i man ngag rlung non bya tshul/ lung pa'i nub byang mtshams su dong khru gang pa'i nang / rdo leb gtsang ma la mtshal gyis padma 'dab brgyad bris/ lte ba la/ suṃ 'dab ma brgyad la yig mgo phyir bstan gyis phuḥbargyad bris dong nang du lte ba'i yig mgo byang du bstan la gan rkyal du bzhag dngos kyi kha gcod pa'i rdo leb kyi nang la mtshal gyis yi ge suṃ dang phyi mar sna tshogs rdo rje bris/ yig mgo lhor bstan kha sbub tu bkab pa'i steng sa gtsang mas las khung snyoms par byas la/ sātstsha rab gnas can nam rdo rje gang rung bzhag de nyid kyi drung ngam rang gi sgrub khang gi nang du'ang rung ste/ skyabs sems brag rdzong ma bzhin/ tshad med bzhi sgom/ swa bha wa'i sngags brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag che zhing cher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rnga yab 'phyar zhing / g.yon rin po che'i zo ba bsnams pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing nas/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis rlung lha pho mo mdog ljang gu g.yas ba dan cung zad 'dril ba/ g.yon na rkyal pa srub med pa'i nang du rlung thams cad bsdus nas btsir pa'i steng na 'gyings shing bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bra nag nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje nag po chen po oṃ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dong nang dang steng gi suṃ gnyis ri rab tu gyur pa'i nang du yaṃ sngon po/ ri rab de gnyis sbrul gyis bcings te rlung thams cad btsir bar gyur/ rang nag po chen por gsal pa'i rnga yab kyis rlung rnams bsdus nas g.yon gyi zo ba'i nang du bcug pas rlung gi rgyu tsam yang med par gyur/ ces brjod la dmigs pa gsal po dang ldan pas/ oṃ ti ti ti til nan/ bha yu raṃ bha na rlung bum par chud swāhā/ zhes ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen pos sems can thams cad rlung gi 'jigs pa las skyabs tu gsol dang / dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis sogs brag rdzong ma'i mjug bzhin no/ /gal te des ma thub na shā sa na mang du sngags pa'i yungs dkar rlung gang nas ldang ba'i phyogs der 'phang zhing / shā sa na'i rjes su oṃ ti ti sogs gong gi sngags btags pa drag tu bzla'o/ /don grub na dong nang dang steng gi rdo leb bton la yi ge 'dab brgyad dang rdo rje rnams dri bzang gi chus bkru/ sa phyogs de nyid du dkar gtor gtsang ma/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis brgyan pa chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pa bsham/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ mchod gtor/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod du lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa gtor ma rnams zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ arghaṃ nas/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ aḥhūm̐/ mdun du skad cig gis rlung lha sngon po ri dwags la zhon pa g.yas ba dan/ g.yon dbugs rkyal 'dzin pa/

dar dang rin po che'i rgyan dang rlung lha'i tshogs gyis bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rlung lha 'khor dang bcas pa a karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes dang / hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis bkug dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ nam mkha' mdzod gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ wa ya we sa pā ri wā ra na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bhi shwa nas/ ghṛhna daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swāhā/ bdun la sogs pas phul/ oṃ wa ya we sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ pra titstshaḥye swāhā/ de bzhin du shapta'i bar la'ang 'gre'o/ /rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /nas/ phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar/ ma 'byor pa dang nas/ bzod par mdzod/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir nas/ thams cad tha dad 'gro bar gyis/ wa ya we sa pā ri wā ra gatstshaḥ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ mchod gtor de nyid du dor ro// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 kun dga' blo gros/ rdo rje nag po chen po la klu chen brgyad bskor gyi char 'bebs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
